verdict.rationale: Gitea is a free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted Git service. It ships as a single binary and an official container image, runs on many OSes and architectures, and supports single-server and replicated deployments. Community reports independently confirm easy self-hosting on VPSes, Docker, a Raspberry Pi-class machine and a USB stick, plus simple binary-swap upgrades.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license. Full control, unlimited users and repositories.
or use container (docker/podman/etc) to deploy on your own server with the official image.
This makes it convenient for individual developers or small teams to set up and manage their own Git services.
Provides flexible deployment options, supporting both single server setups and replication configurations.
